findings.how_to_check: Run python replication/check_claims.py to observe 14 claims marked PENDING. Inspect replication/results/create_figures_SSHA2025.tex to verify it contains zero \newcommand macro entries.
findings.suggested_fix: Decouple CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do into an intermediate build script and an exhibit/macro generation script that reads temp.dta, or place an if $REP_SKIP_REBUILD == 0 block around lines 48-96 inside create_figures_SSHA2025.do so Table 4, Figures 3-4, and the 14 repnum macros are generated from the existing temp.dta during -SkipRebuild runs.
findings.title: SkipRebuild bypasses Table 4 generation and leaves results/create_figures_SSHA2025.tex empty with 14 pending claims
findings.what_the_code_does: In replication/run_machineA.do:78-79, setting REP_SKIP_REBUILD=1 excludes create_figures_SSHA2025 from local scripts. Although documentation states that Table 4 numbers are preserved from the last full run, replication/results/create_figures_SSHA2025.tex contains only header comments and no \newcommand macros. As a result, running Run-MachineA.ps1 -SkipRebuild never verifies or regenerates Table 4 (avg_performance_allstates.tex) or Figures 3-4, and check_claims.py leaves 14 claims permanently in PENDING status.
findings.why_it_matters: An external or local replicator running the fast replication tier cannot reproduce or check Table 4 or the 14 dependent in-text claims, because intermediate data rebuilding (lines 48-96) is coupled with exhibit and macro production (lines 107-400) in a single script that is skipped in its entirety.

findings.how_to_check: Clone the repository to an alternate path or run from another drive and execute Stata /b do replication/run_machineA.do; Stata immediately halts with error r(601) attempting to open D:/repos/fixing_transcription_errors/replication/config.do.
findings.location: replication/run_machineA.do:22, CODE/compute_legibility_quartiles.do:16, CODE/compute_model_agreement_on_discordant.do:47, CODE/compute_race_linkage_rates.do:13, CODE/compute_subgroup_linkage_rates.do:15, CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:24, CODE/make_balance_exhibits.do:30, CODE/verify_inmates_and_county_stats.do:13, replication/config.do:26-29
findings.suggested_fix: Pass the repository root path via global macro or command-line argument from the PowerShell runners, use relative paths where appropriate, and allow config.do to accept user-defined path overrides or environment variables instead of hardcoding hostnames and drives.
findings.title: Hardcoded absolute bootstrap paths to config.do prevent replication on any clone path or external host
findings.what_the_code_does: While replication/config.do was introduced as the single location for machine-specific paths, replication/run_machineA.do:22 and all seven analysis scripts load it via hardcoded absolute path do "D:/repos/fixing_transcription_errors/replication/config.do". Furthermore, config.do:26-29 immediately exits with code 198 if c(hostname) is not ARTS-ECON-CM, and Run-MachineA.ps1:27 hardcodes paper repo path D:\repos\6638fa0fd89fbec05130caeb.
findings.why_it_matters: Any replicator cloning the repository to a different directory, drive, or machine cannot run either the master runner or individual scripts standalone, as Stata fails trying to open config.do at the hardcoded D:/repos/... location before any configuration can take effect.

findings.how_to_check: On the 1940 census extract or intermediate temp.dta, run count if missing(age) & female==0 and count if missing(age) & sex==1 to verify the number of observations retained solely because of missing age.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the filters to keep if age>=10 & !missing(age) & female==0 and keep if sex==1 & age>=10 & !missing(age), report the number of missing-age records dropped, and recompute the registered counts.
findings.title: Age restriction age>=10 retains observations with missing age due to Stata missing value ordering
findings.what_the_code_does: The sample construction uses keep if age>=10 & female==0 in make_balance_exhibits.do:47 and keep if sex==1 & age>=10 in create_figures_SSHA2025.do:92. In Stata, numeric missing values exceed all finite numbers (. >= 10 is true), so observations with missing age are retained in the sample and incorporated into nMalesTen (55,350,482) and nAnalysis (51,066,203) registered in claims.toml.
findings.why_it_matters: If any census records have missing age, the headline population count (55,350,482), analysis sample size (51,066,203), and Table 2-3 balance statistics erroneously include individuals with unknown age. While acknowledged as a known hazard in README.md:214 and claims.toml:398, the uncorrected sample counts continue to be codified as verified targets.

findings.how_to_check: Inspect replication/run_machineA.do:44 and CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:373 to trace the macro definition of code back to line 14.
findings.suggested_fix: Update CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:373 to execute do "$REP_REPO/CODE/label_socio_demo.do" (or use config.do's REP_REPO global) to ensure the version-controlled script is executed.
findings.title: Preflight validates repository label_socio_demo.do but create_figures_SSHA2025.do executes uncommitted Dropbox copy
findings.what_the_code_does: Preflight assertion in replication/run_machineA.do:44 checks that $REP_REPO/CODE/label_socio_demo.do exists. However, CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:14 defines local code "`dropbox'fixing_transcription_errors\CODE\" and line 373 runs do "`code'label_socio_demo.do", executing the file from D:\SNU ECON Dropbox\sam hwang\... rather than the repository.
findings.why_it_matters: Preflight confirms the presence of the version-controlled script, but the pipeline executes an external Dropbox copy. Any modifications committed to label_socio_demo.do in git will not affect the figures, creating silent divergence between git tracking and actual execution.

review_limits: Census microdata and intermediate .dta files located on external drives (D:/SNU ECON Dropbox and F:/) were not accessible in the review sandbox, precluding empirical calculation of missing age counts or linkage rate effects.

The Stata pipeline was not executed due to data externalization and multi-hour execution runtime; runtime behavior and macro outputs were audited through static code analysis and inspection of committed result artifacts.
No paper draft was supplied with the review request; claims were evaluated solely through claims.toml, claims_report.md, and git logs.
Only the requested dimensions ('correctness' and 'replication') were reviewed; 'claims-vs-code' and 'identification' were excluded from scope.
summary: The commit establishes a valuable replication framework with automated claim checking and structured macro exports, but critical portability and workflow gaps remain. Most importantly, running the driver with -SkipRebuild omits create_figures_SSHA2025.do entirely, leaving Table 4 unverified and 14 claims permanently in PENDING status because create_figures_SSHA2025.tex was committed empty. In addition, hardcoded absolute repository paths across the do-files defeat the path centralization config.do was intended to provide.

verified_clean.evidence: replication/stata/repnum.ado:54-58 asserts !missing(scalar) and halts with return code 504 if a scalar is missing, preventing '.' from reaching LaTeX files.
replication/stata/repnum.ado:38-41 enforces ^[A-Za-z]+$ on all macro keys, ensuring generated LaTeX commands contain only valid letters.
CODE/compute_model_agreement_on_discordant.do:141-144 asserts anc_h + fs_h + nei_h + nom_h == disc_h in every state, ensuring exhaustive and mutually exclusive classification before export.
CODE/compute_model_agreement_on_discordant.do:159-166 verifies nok == nexpected (49 jurisdictions), erasing CSV output and exiting with code 459 if any state fails.
CODE/make_balance_exhibits.do:77-80 verifies that congruent and incongruent counts exhaust the analysis sample (n_cong + n_inc == n_as) before writing tables or repnum macros.
CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:382-385 counts non-improvements with !missing(v8, v9) and isolates missing(v8)|missing(v9) separately, avoiding false passes from Stata's . > 0 semantics.
CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:3 explicitly sets set seed 1000 before running stochastic or sampling procedures.
replication/check_claims.py:101-106 implements Decimal quantize with ROUND_HALF_UP matching draft printed precision, reliably catching rounding errors such as intro-legibility.
